title: console: an author cannot edit or delete their own comment on a record page, though sys_comment's data layer allows both (split from objectui#12249)
body:
Filing gate ①: a reproduced, user-visible product gap, split from objectstack-ai/objectui#12249 as triage `6121957396` directs ("An edit or delete capability nothing declares is a new card, not this list"). objectui#12249 keeps the reply half, which is delivered on `main` and pinned by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12267.

Reader: objectui triage (grade, type, `domain:*` and route). The fork below decides the lane, so ⛔ this seat does not pre-route it.
Filed by: `domain:ui` seat 1, `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`, from the measurement in os-dev report `6127465901` on objectui#12249, re-read by the seat on `origin/main`.
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, all states), read when this card was created:
- objectui, `edit or delete own comment on record page activity feed`: 3 hits (#12249 itself, the positive control; #12078 closed: reactions as `sys_comment_reaction` rows; #3268 closed: feed items not cleared between records). None on point.
- objectui, `CommentThread onEditComment onDeleteComment not mounted record page`: 1 hit (#12249).
- objectstack, `sys_comment edit delete own comment UI is_edited edited_at`: 4 hits (#22500, #22573, #4630, #4756, all closed: reactions, retirement, authorization, `visibility`/`reply_count`). None on point.

## What happens

Source: the 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`), zh-CN; recorded on objectui#12249.

- **Reach:** CASE-00041 (活动) and KA-0005 (讨论). After `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment` → 201, the only controls on the author's own comment are 添加表情回应 (add reaction) and, on some entries, 查看来源 (view source). There is no edit and no delete. Measured 2 of 2.

## What the platform already declares and holds (read on `origin/main`: objectstack `df7a137`, objectui `0cd322d`)

- **Spec, the object level:** `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, `managedBy`'s `platform` value: "User-owned business data. Generic New / Import / Edit / Delete affordances are all shown. Example: the user's own `sys_attachment`, `sys_comment`."
- **Spec, the feed block:** `RecordActivityProps` declares no edit or delete key. Its authorable keys are `aria`, `enableMentions`, `enableReactions`, `enableThreading`, `filterMode`, `limit`, `showCommentInput`, `showCompleted`, `showFilterToggle`, `showSubscriptionToggle`, `types` and `unifiedTimeline` (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`; the same set in the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0).
- **Data layer:** `sys_comment` (objectstack `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts`) carries `is_edited` and `edited_at`. `comment-access-hooks.ts` lets the author update and delete their own comment ("authors govern their own words").
- **objectui:** `@object-ui/collaboration`'s `CommentThread` implements owner-gated edit and delete (`onEditComment`, `onDeleteComment`). No source file in `packages/app-shell/src` or `packages/plugin-detail/src` mounts it; the only reference there is one test. Positive control: `RecordActivityTimeline` is referenced by 29 files in the same population. The record page's feed is `RecordActivityTimeline`, which offers no edit or delete.

## The fork (for triage)

- **A.** The record feed honours the object-level declaration: the author's own `sys_comment` row offers edit and delete with no new key. This is objectui work in `domain:ui`, with the delete behind the console's ordinary destructive-action confirm.
- **B.** The feed block needs its own declaration (a `RecordActivityProps` key). That widens a published spec surface, so it is `domain:spec` work and owes a contract review, or a decision card if the key's existence is itself the question.

## Acceptance

On a record page whose feed shows comments, the author of a comment can edit and delete it, the server's own rule decides who may, and the edit marks the comment as edited. Or a ruling records why the feed withholds them.

---
Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`).
